question: Which payment rails are being rebuilt around Swift, or alongside it?
answer: The world record holds 35 dated payment-plumbing moves in 10 regions, January 6, 2025 to July 7, 2026: China's CIPS signing foreign banks, BRICS Pay targeted for a pilot, Africa's PAPSS, Indonesia's QRIS reaching Japan, Korea and China, Project Nexus, and the ECB's Pontes and Appia links. Swift's own shared ledger has four readings: announced September 29, 2025; 'controlled initial use preparing' on the Japan map (September 15, 2026); 'MVP ready; pilots pending', grade M4, on the UK map (September 14, 2026); and, newest, 17 listed banks and 6 bank-published pilot transactions (October 19, 2026).

sections.title: Swift, reconciled
sections.sub: The four readings side by side; the newest is the Swift ledger page.

items.title: Swift shared ledger: one row, four readings
kv: SWIFT announces it will add a blockchain-based shared ledger to its core infrastructure with thirty-plus global banks — 24/7 tokenized-deposit cross-border payments. The rail that cut Russia off in 2022 rebuilds itself in the challengers' image. Incumbents don't die; they absorb. · Study headline: SWIFT's blockchain ledger is moving real money
Status: controlled initial use preparing · Limit: No completed Japanese production transaction or disclosed yen loss rule existed at cutoff.
Status: MVP ready; pilots pending · Maturity grade: M4 · authorised or production-bound · Next record to look for: First completed pilot, exact cash leg, finality, liquidity and correction evidence.
October 19, 2026 · Swift ledger page (crypto and networks master)

Swift lists 17 banks; 6 bank-published pilot transactions, published August 19, 2026 to September 7, 2026. Status: Real money has moved in bank-reported controlled transactions, but banks call them 'live pilots' or a 'controlled proof of concept' and Swift calls this an 'initial controlled go-live phase'. No general availability date. · What the page shows: the focused page (Oct 19, 2026) lists 17 banks and 6 bank-published pilot transactions · Note: S080 card: six bank-published pilot transactions dated Aug 19 - Sep 7, 2026 on the focused page.

items.title: Pan unveils the Hong Kong package: Southbound Bond Connect quota to 800 billion yuan, a central clearing system for gold with a Shanghai delivery connect, the RMB facility to 500 billion …
items.text: Pan unveils the Hong Kong package: Southbound Bond Connect quota to 800 billion yuan, a central clearing system for gold with a Shanghai delivery connect, the RMB facility to 500 billion, and a pledge to shift FX-reserve investment into Hong Kong assets. Gold clearing, yuan liquidity and reserve money, all routed through the one Chinese city the dollar system still recognizes.
kv: Beijing Moves Reserves and Gold Clearing to Hong Kong

items.title: The HKMA launches EnsembleTX — Project Ensemble's pilot for real-value transactions in tokenized deposits and digital assets.
items.text: The HKMA launches EnsembleTX — Project Ensemble's pilot for real-value transactions in tokenized deposits and digital assets. The same month, Hong Kong prices a HK$10 billion tokenized government bond, the world's first settling partly in tokenized central-bank money including e-CNY.
kv: Hong Kong Starts Settling Real Money on the Chain

items.title: The PBoC renews swap lines with the ECB — 350 billion yuan — the Swiss National Bank and Hungary's central bank.
items.text: The PBoC renews swap lines with the ECB — 350 billion yuan — the Swiss National Bank and Hungary's central bank. The quiet lattice of yuan liquidity under Europe, maintained on schedule.
kv: Source link (not a secure link, shown as text)

items.title: PBoC, HKMA and the SFC expand Southbound Bond Connect to onshore brokers, funds, insurers and wealth managers, with offshore yuan repo enhancements.
items.text: PBoC, HKMA and the SFC expand Southbound Bond Connect to onshore brokers, funds, insurers and wealth managers, with offshore yuan repo enhancements. The mainland's money gets more ways into Hong Kong's market — the pressure valve opens by decree.

items.title: CIPS signs six foreign direct participants spanning Africa, the Gulf, Central Asia and Southeast Asia — Standard Bank, Afreximbank, First Abu Dhabi among them.
items.text: CIPS signs six foreign direct participants spanning Africa, the Gulf, Central Asia and Southeast Asia — Standard Bank, Afreximbank, First Abu Dhabi among them. The yuan's clearing rail grows exactly where the dollar's sanctions bite hardest.
kv: China's Clearing Rail Signs Its First Foreign Banks

items.title: Bolivia ends the 6.96 peg held since 2011 and floats the boliviano — opening near 9.73 to the dollar, a 40% devaluation by market.
items.text: Bolivia ends the 6.96 peg held since 2011 and floats the boliviano — opening near 9.73 to the dollar, a 40% devaluation by market. Fifteen years of fixed money end in one resolution. The country that pays for fuel in Tether now lets the market name its currency's price.

items.title: Bessent announces Argentina fully repaid the $20 billion swap line — only $2.5 billion ever drawn — at a profit to the US taxpayer.
items.text: Bessent announces Argentina fully repaid the $20 billion swap line — only $2.5 billion ever drawn — at a profit to the US taxpayer. The ESF play worked: the peso held, Milei won, and the Treasury banked the carry. The empire's carrot, returned with interest.

items.title: New president Paz issues the Decreto por la Patria — national economic emergency, fuel subsidies gone overnight, prices doubling.
items.text: New president Paz issues the Decreto por la Patria — national economic emergency, fuel subsidies gone overnight, prices doubling. The fiscal prelude to killing the peg. When the dollars run out, the decrees get biblical names.

items.title: The US Treasury buys pesos outright and opens a $20 billion ESF swap line with Argentina's central bank — Trump conditioning it publicly on Milei winning the midterms.
items.text: The US Treasury buys pesos outright and opens a $20 billion ESF swap line with Argentina's central bank — Trump conditioning it publicly on Milei winning the midterms. The Exchange Stabilization Fund, the quietest weapon in the Treasury, deployed as campaign finance for an ally's currency.

items.title: Three days after the IMF approves a $20 billion program, Argentina dismantles the cepo: free dollar purchases, profit repatriation, the peso in a crawling band.
items.text: Three days after the IMF approves a $20 billion program, Argentina dismantles the cepo: free dollar purchases, profit repatriation, the peso in a crawling band. Fourteen years of capital controls end in a weekend.
kv: Milei Tears Down the Currency Wall

items.title: The Lower House passes the bill moving crypto into the securities law — insider-trading bans, issuer disclosure, the ETF path, harsher penalties for unlicensed operators.
items.text: The Lower House passes the bill moving crypto into the securities law — insider-trading bans, issuer disclosure, the ETF path, harsher penalties for unlicensed operators. Cabinet approved it April 10; the Upper House vote is still pending. Japan is one vote away from treating crypto like stocks.
kv: Japan's Lower House Passes the Crypto-as-Securities Law

items.title: Progmat's consortium launches a forty-institution working group — the megabanks, Nomura, BlackRock Japan, State Street — to tokenize JGBs and put the $1.6 trillion repo market on-chain with …
items.text: Progmat's consortium launches a forty-institution working group — the megabanks, Nomura, BlackRock Japan, State Street — to tokenize JGBs and put the $1.6 trillion repo market on-chain with same-day settlement, live target end of 2026. The register of Japan's own debt heads for the ledger, the same move the DTC made in Washington.
kv: Japan Moves Its Bond Market Toward the Chain

items.title: The Financial System Council's working group publishes its report: move crypto out of the Payment Services Act and into the FIEA, the securities law.
items.text: The Financial System Council's working group publishes its report: move crypto out of the Payment Services Act and into the FIEA, the securities law. Insider-trading bans, issuer disclosure, an ETF path. The paper trail runs back to the FSA's April discussion paper — Japan spent 2025 deciding that crypto is capital markets, not payments.

items.title: Indonesia begins letting commodity exporters hold their export earnings in yuan.
items.text: Indonesia begins letting commodity exporters hold their export earnings in yuan. A one-line rule change in the export-proceeds regime — and a quiet hole in the dollar's oldest privilege, invoicing.

items.title: QRIS cross-border goes live with China, a month after Korea — the network now spans Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, Korea and China, with India next.
items.text: QRIS cross-border goes live with China, a month after Korea — the network now spans Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, Korea and China, with India next. Sixty million Indonesians are the target user base for a payment map of Asia with no dollar on it.

items.title: Bank Indonesia joins Project Nexus as the sixth full member — BI-FAST wired into the BIS-designed instant-payment mesh with India, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand, while …
items.text: Bank Indonesia joins Project Nexus as the sixth full member — BI-FAST wired into the BIS-designed instant-payment mesh with India, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand, while keeping settlement onshore "to safeguard national sovereignty." The plumbing internationalizes; the money stays home.
kv: Indonesia Wires Into the Global Instant-Payment Grid

items.title: Indonesia and China launch expanded yuan-rupiah local-currency settlement alongside QR interconnection — the framework that feeds a 163% year-on-year surge in non-dollar trade settlement.
items.text: Indonesia and China launch expanded yuan-rupiah local-currency settlement alongside QR interconnection — the framework that feeds a 163% year-on-year surge in non-dollar trade settlement. Two currencies agreeing to stop renting the dollar for their own trade.
kv: Jakarta and Beijing Cut Out the Dollar

items.title: QRIS goes live in Japan — Indonesian phones paying Osaka merchants without a dollar in the middle — first leg of Bank Indonesia's push to seven QR-linked markets.
items.text: QRIS goes live in Japan — Indonesian phones paying Osaka merchants without a dollar in the middle — first leg of Bank Indonesia's push to seven QR-linked markets. De-dollarization not as summit communiqué but as a checkout counter.
kv: Indonesia's QR Code Lands in Japan

items.title: Indonesia is admitted as a full BRICS member — the largest economy in Southeast Asia walks into the bloc six days into the year, and local-currency-settlement talks start at once.
items.text: Indonesia is admitted as a full BRICS member — the largest economy in Southeast Asia walks into the bloc six days into the year, and local-currency-settlement talks start at once. The world's biggest archipelago picks multipolar.

items.title: The 2026 Economic Growth Strategy: spot crypto ETFs allowed this year, stablecoin licensing and reserve rules, a won-internationalization roadmap in the first half, and 24-hour onshore FX …
items.text: The 2026 Economic Growth Strategy: spot crypto ETFs allowed this year, stablecoin licensing and reserve rules, a won-internationalization roadmap in the first half, and 24-hour onshore FX trading from July. Korea decides its currency needs to work the night shift.
kv: Korea Promises ETFs, Stablecoin Rules and a Global Won

items.title: Korea ends the fourteen-year restriction on domestic financial firms buying kimchi bonds — explicitly to relieve dollar-drain pressure after some $42 billion flowed into overseas stocks and …
items.text: Korea ends the fourteen-year restriction on domestic financial firms buying kimchi bonds — explicitly to relieve dollar-drain pressure after some $42 billion flowed into overseas stocks and stablecoins in one quarter. The token outflow is now bending Korea's FX plumbing.
kv: Korea Unblocks Kimchi Bonds to Stem the Dollar Drain

items.title: ISO 20022 coexistence ends: SWIFT retires the MT payment messages after 48 years, and the richer MX format becomes the sole language of cross-border payment instructions.
items.text: ISO 20022 coexistence ends: SWIFT retires the MT payment messages after 48 years, and the richer MX format becomes the sole language of cross-border payment instructions. The same weekend the G20 declares without America. The pipes were relaid while everyone watched the coins.

items.title: The FSB's own progress report admits the G20's 2027 cross-border payment targets are unlikely to be met.
items.text: The FSB's own progress report admits the G20's 2027 cross-border payment targets are unlikely to be met. The official reform of the old rails is failing on schedule — which is exactly why the token rails and the state ledgers are both racing to replace them.

items.title: SWIFT announces it will add a blockchain-based shared ledger to its core infrastructure with thirty-plus global banks — 24/7 tokenized-deposit cross-border payments.
items.text: SWIFT announces it will add a blockchain-based shared ledger to its core infrastructure with thirty-plus global banks — 24/7 tokenized-deposit cross-border payments. The rail that cut Russia off in 2022 rebuilds itself in the challengers' image. Incumbents don't die; they absorb.

Unresolved; every reading is shown on this page.

items.title: The same day, Pablo Hernández de Cos takes the BIS general managership from Carstens and Andrew Bailey takes the FSB chair.
items.text: The same day, Pablo Hernández de Cos takes the BIS general managership from Carstens and Andrew Bailey takes the FSB chair. The two global money institutions change hands at once — into the hands of two men who spent the year warning about stablecoins.
kv: New Hands at the BIS and FSB

items.title: Under the first African G20 presidency, finance ministers sign the first-ever ministerial declaration on debt sustainability, plus the Africa Engagement Framework and a Cost of Capital …
items.text: Under the first African G20 presidency, finance ministers sign the first-ever ministerial declaration on debt sustainability, plus the Africa Engagement Framework and a Cost of Capital Commission. The continent that pays the most to borrow puts the price of money itself on the agenda.

items.title: ECOWAS sets the Eco single currency for July 1, 2027 — willing members only, the fifth deadline in the project's life — while the Sahel junta bloc, out of ECOWAS entirely, talks up a …
items.text: ECOWAS sets the Eco single currency for July 1, 2027 — willing members only, the fifth deadline in the project's life — while the Sahel junta bloc, out of ECOWAS entirely, talks up a gold-backed rival and a CFA exit. (Announcement date reported early August; day unverified.) Two Africas, two poles.
kv: West Africa Names a Date, Again

items.title: PAPSS and Interstellar launch the African Currency Marketplace on blockchain rails — direct African-currency-to-African-currency exchange, cutting the dollar out of the middle of …
items.text: PAPSS and Interstellar launch the African Currency Marketplace on blockchain rails — direct African-currency-to-African-currency exchange, cutting the dollar out of the middle of intra-African trade and the five billion a year it costs. The same day, Morocco joins PAPSS as its seventeenth country.

items.title: The T+1 settlement regulation is published in the Official Journal — Europe's settlement cycle shortens to one day on October 11, 2027, the same date as Britain's.
items.text: The T+1 settlement regulation is published in the Official Journal — Europe's settlement cycle shortens to one day on October 11, 2027, the same date as Britain's. The whole Atlantic is compressing settlement time while the tokenizers promise zero.
kv: Europe Sets Its Settlement Clock to T+1

items.title: The ECB approves dual-track DLT settlement in central-bank money: Pontes, a pilot link between DLT platforms and TARGET by late 2026, and Appia, the long-term blueprint for a tokenized …
items.text: The ECB approves dual-track DLT settlement in central-bank money: Pontes, a pilot link between DLT platforms and TARGET by late 2026, and Appia, the long-term blueprint for a tokenized wholesale ecosystem. Europe's answer to tokenization: bring the chain to the central bank, never the reverse.
kv: The ECB Builds Two Bridges to the Chain

items.title: The Commission postpones Basel III's market-risk rules a second time, to 2027 — citing US non-implementation outright.
items.text: The Commission postpones Basel III's market-risk rules a second time, to 2027 — citing US non-implementation outright. The global capital standard now waits on a Washington that has stopped waiting for anyone.
kv: Brussels Delays Basel Again Because America Won't Move

items.title: The Commission publishes the Savings and Investments Union strategy — the plan to move some ten trillion euros of bank deposits into capital-market investment.
items.text: The Commission publishes the Savings and Investments Union strategy — the plan to move some ten trillion euros of bank deposits into capital-market investment. The parent frame for everything Brussels did to market plumbing this cycle: the people's savings, put to work.
kv: Brussels Eyes Ten Trillion in Sleeping Deposits

items.title: The Rio summit presents the technical report on a BRICS cross-border payments system and targets a BRICS Pay pilot by end-2026 — while the 126-point declaration never once says …
items.text: The Rio summit presents the technical report on a BRICS cross-border payments system and targets a BRICS Pay pilot by end-2026 — while the 126-point declaration never once says "de-dollarization" and the common currency is quietly buried. Trump's 100% tariff threat killed the currency in one sentence; the plumbing survives because plumbing is deniable.
kv: BRICS Drops the Currency and Keeps the Plumbing

items.title: RT2 goes live at the Bank of England — the renewed real-time gross settlement service, the new core ledger of sterling, built for broader access and future synchronization with outside …
items.text: RT2 goes live at the Bank of England — the renewed real-time gross settlement service, the new core ledger of sterling, built for broader access and future synchronization with outside asset ledgers. The Bank's answer to tokenization: rebuild the middle, keep the middle.
kv: Sterling Gets a New Core Ledger

items.title: The government accepts every Accelerated Settlement Taskforce recommendation and commits to one-day settlement from October 11, 2027 — Treasury, FCA and Bank of England jointly.
items.text: The government accepts every Accelerated Settlement Taskforce recommendation and commits to one-day settlement from October 11, 2027 — Treasury, FCA and Bank of England jointly. The old plumbing speeds up to keep the tokenizers from making it look slow.
